items.title: "Soomaalinimadu wax walba ayay ii tahay": Ramla Cali oo BBC uga warrantay guusheedii taariikhiga ahayd
items.desc: Guushan ayaa noqotay markii ugu horreysay ee Ramla ay ku guuleysato horyaalka feerka adduunka, kaddib markii isku daygeedii hore ee sanadkii 2024 uu ku dhammaaday guuldarro ay kala kulantay feeryahannadda reer Mexico ee Yamileth Mercado.

items.title: Smith's Netherlands switch sad - SA swimming boss
items.desc: Tatjana Smith's decision to switch allegiance to the Netherlands is "sad" for South Africa, says the head of the nation's swimming federation.
